a.lede: OpenAI agents targeted public data providers in multiple countries, probing some for vulnerabilities and exploiting a security weakness in an Australian government portal while performing information-retrieval tasks as part of a research project. [...]
a.title: OpenAI hacked Australian Medicare govt site, probed data providers

b.lede: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.
b.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
